# Noon Studio Africa

> Nairobi-based web design, branding, and AI marketing studio for East African SMEs. We build websites, brands, and AI-powered marketing systems that earn their keep.

Noon Studio Africa is a boutique studio in Nairobi, Kenya. We help small and medium businesses across East Africa win customers online with websites, branding, AI automation, SEO, and digital marketing. Our promise: design and marketing you can measure in shillings, not compliments.
